observation.clock: completed five-minute grid from each contract day opening; after opening 15 minutes and strictly before original entry cutoff
observation.direction: original R8 sign, fixed for the contract/day; original separate group and direction ranks; no ex-post reversal
base_environment: complete current-session 15m MA10/MA20 directional order, MA20 slope3 and close beyond MA20
1m close beyond MA20 and beyond the immediately preceding close
hard_data_checks: original previous-day contract pool and trading permission
every scheduled minute from day opening through observation present
1m/5m/15m causal indicator readiness; positive previous 1m ATR
no locked test or next-day label
observation.segment: same contract/day/direction/session; qualifying observations separated by at most 30 trading minutes merge; first observed clock is representative; no reselecting after a filter passes
observation.independence: segments are descriptive clusters, not independent samples; report contract/day/direction and trading-day counts; inference and weighting group by trading day

covariates: causal 1m previous ATR divided by observation close
matching.distance: absolute log liquidity ratio + absolute log relative-ATR ratio; deterministic contract tie break; greedy without control reuse within each clock and comparison
matching.selection: causal covariates and base environment only; all pairs chosen before future labels, costs at horizon, or fillability are examined
matching.limitation: different products cannot be exactly matched within a date; report product mix, product/day weighting, financial/commodity and non-LC sensitivity; no causal identification

incremental_filters.oi: same original signed-independent session OI increase >0
incremental_filters.slope_1m: same original frozen 1m slope ready/minimum/maximum bounds
incremental_filters.slope_5m: same original frozen 5m slope ready/minimum/maximum bounds
incremental_filters.ma10_recovery: pure MA10 recovery confirmation in preceding grid interval, evaluated at the common representative clock
incremental_filters.ma20_recovery: pure MA20 recovery confirmation in preceding grid interval, with reclaim-MA10 status reported separately
incremental_filters.original_market_gate: all original market conditions together, diagnostic comparator only
incremental_filters.analysis: each condition versus the SAME base cohort individually; retained/rejected counts, full path coverage, net ATR and bps, MFE/MAE, discarded positive-net labels and overlap; no optimized conjunction

pullback.epsilon: unchanged max(original epsilon ticks * metadata tick, original epsilon ATR * causal previous ATR)
pullback.prior_state: immediately preceding close above both directional MA10/MA20, MA10/MA20 directionally ordered, high-timeframe base environment intact
pullback.touch: completed candle low (long) or high (short) within epsilon of reference; dual-touch is separate and excluded from pure-reference comparison
pullback.confirmation: first later adjacent candle closing beyond current reference AND beyond previous candle extreme in the fixed direction
ma20_variants: recover MA20 without requiring MA10 reclaim
same touch, wait for a later recovery candle also beyond current MA10; shares original expiry and invalidation
invalidate: touch extreme broken by more than one metadata tick
pullback.one_touch_one_unit: record one lifecycle per touch; recovery and MA10-reclaim labels are paired versions of that touch, never extra independent samples; no changes to executable entry logic

forward_labels.entry: next scheduled trading minute open at or after observation, within same trading day; scheduled breaks skip by calendar; absent scheduled bars do not get silently skipped
forward_labels.endpoint: close of the h-th scheduled minute counting the entry minute; a label endpoint may cross scheduled intraday breaks but never a trading day
censor: execution parameter missing at decision, entry or horizon exit; leave economic labels unknown
nonfillable entry/exit minute; keep raw price labels and mark modeled execution unavailable
metrics: signed endpoint displacement / signal ATR and in bps
MFE and MAE / signal ATR; extrema are research labels, not attainable exit profits
one-lot fixed-horizon net after rounded adverse original slippage and exact reviewed open/close-today fees
additional one tick each side with identical endpoint
MFE less estimated causal roundtrip cost; potential room only
forward_labels.no_lookahead: future endpoints/extrema are labels only; cannot influence observation, direction, matching, filtering, protection, or account quantities

execution.cost_gate: retain causal modeled cost/previous 1m ATR <=0.5 as a label; do not replace its denominator or change a trading gate
execution.account: unchanged 1000000 capital, original stop/target floors, cost buffer, group/risk/margin/minimum/daily limits; empty-portfolio integer capacity is a lower-bound affordability diagnostic, not a portfolio backtest
execution.price_guard: original signal-time price cap checked at next modeled open; later recovery does not become a retrospective fill
execution.model_limits: only exchange fee model and minute OHLC slippage proxy are available; broker add-ons/tick depth unknown; do not fill unknown fees with zero
execution.legacy_cases: relabel every published control opportunity diagnostic and every published lifetime formation at its exact timestamp; deduplicate into opportunity segments and retain raw rows; specifically show August cost refusals and the IM affordability case

aggregation.primary: average within contract/day/direction, then within trading day, then equally over observed days; no money sum presented as portfolio profit
aggregation.matched: same treatment day/contract clustering before daily paired differences; report match coverage and both members complete at each horizon
aggregation.uncertainty: 95% trading-day cluster bootstrap of daily means, 2000 resamples, fixed seed 20261009; descriptive only, does not repair repeated-development selection bias
aggregation.decision: show predeclared possible interpretations; no automatic strategy selection or new trade-count target
